_comment: macOS MTProto seeds are IP literals for the Chengdu dev datacenter, TCP port 10443. DC 1 and DC 2 are that same address: debug builds start on DC 1 and release builds start on DC 2. Do not put a hostname in seeds. Public keys are the PKCS#1 blocks from the iOS client, newest first; they are the same blocks as the Android client. Edit this file, then run python3 tellomi/apply_mtproto.py --generate.
